scenes.summary: Inside the dam, you encounter Roger, a UWST expert who studies fungi. But he's raving, utterly terrified. Before you can snap him out of it, he runs off.

lines.text: Roger? Hey, wake up! It's me, Pan Yuan.
I'm just a little mushroom ... nobody's gonna see me...
You know him?
He was part of the UWST crew that helped build the dam. He's also their mycologist.
Roger, do you still remember me?
Uncle Pan, please leave this to me.
Honey waffle is coming right —
No... It ... it saw me... Go! Get out of here!

scenes.summary: After defeating the enemies, Roger's scent appears once more.

lines.text: They've been in the hallucination too long ... the mushrooms have already eaten their minds.
Now even my honey waffle won't do the trick.
Oooh, I smell Mr. Roger again...
To the soil we go ... rot gives us new life...
What in the world are they going on about...
They're totally convinced they're mushrooms now.

scenes.summary: You use honey waffles to wake Roger up.

lines.text: Arrrgh... Everything's spinning...
He's back.
Roger! Breathe, easy now. It's me!
Da Pan? Endmin? Wh-why are you here ... a-and where am I?
Mr. Roger, please stay calm. We're here to help.
Can you help us open the door first?

options: Wow, you can run this fast in illusions?

lines.text: The mushrooms are ... walking?
So walking mushrooms really do exist!
Oh I know! It's the bad threads that are feeding them!
Then we take out these mushrooms first!

scenes.summary: The Landbreaker's younger brother is also hunting the Malignant Hyphal Mass. His scent leads you to a strange, sealed room. The chilly spores inside might be useful somehow.

lines.text: The scent's definitely coming from here...
But this is a dead end.
That's weird... My nose's lying.
No, my nose's fine. He's definitely here.
The scent is strongest this way... Let's follow it...
Careful! You're about to walk into a wall!
The scent ... it's right in front of my nose ... but why is there a wall here?
If those spores can mess with your head, this wall might not even be real.
Move it — or I'm throwing a honey waffle at you.
I'll count to three — two — Ahchoo! What's that smell? My nose's all tingly! Ahchoo! Ah—choo!
Kay, dip your honey waffle in those chilly spores and toss it.
Got it! ACHOO!

scenes.summary: You finally find the Landbreaker's younger brother. He tells you the Malignant Hyphal Mass is located at the very top of the dam.

lines.text: I ... I have to go up! It's up there!
You're way too weak to be going anywhere!
I'm not scared. I can tell what's real and what's not.
C'mon, Endmin. Let's go get it!
You... I remember you. You shared food with us before.
Something's up there you said?
The mushroom leader. I tracked it all the way here. It's at the top.
The mushroom leader ... is the bad mass?
What mass? All I know is — it's connected to all the threads. It makes you see what's not there. Plenty got trapped.
I made it this far, but I couldn't go any further... It trapped me too.
Sounds like it's exactly the Malignant Hyphal Mass we're looking for, and it's close.
Please take me up there with you. I want to avenge everyone.
Look at you... I wouldn't recommend going up. Your brother's also waiting for you.
My brother? Is he okay...
Instead of pushing yourself up there, you should go back to him!
But the mushroom leader...
Don't worry about it. The Endmin and I will handle that big meanie mushroom!
Alright ... please be careful. It can see what you want most, and use it to make you see things that aren't real.
Your brother is still a bit woozy, but it's nothing serious.

options: Let's go now then.
I'll need some time to prepare.

lines.text: Mr. Roger, are all the UWST workers here?
One girl's missing... She was just with us. I don't know where she's gone.
Hmm! I'll go look for her.

scenes.summary: After regaining consciousness, Roger tells you that a giant mushroom is spreading hallucinogenic spores, causing the recent anomalies. Kay volunteers to use her honey waffles to wake the other UWST crew mates trapped in hallucinations.

lines.text: There are other workers trapped here too.
The UWST noticed the Blight Tide had receded from this area, so they sent us to recover equipment and data.
But right after we stepped inside, things felt wrong ... and then we all passed out.
I guess ... ⟦key|Strain E21⟧ from back then might be the problem.
Strain? You mean the one you...
Yes ... The mushroom strain I cultivated inside the dam. It had massive yields and produced sweet spores.
I just wanted to improve everyone's food...
They should have all been destroyed before the evacuation back then ... how did it become this huge?
So it really isn't just an ordinary mushroom...
If I'd known this would happen, I would've brought all the antidotes from my lab. How are we supposed to wake everyone up now...
Don't you worry! My honey waffle can wake everybody up!
Just leave it to me. I've got enough people to help me this time! We'll save them all!
Those sweet spores used to be completely harmless...
Wait, what are you doing here?! Don't tell me the spores have spread to other areas... Have people outside the dam been affected too?!
Oh no no no! This is really, really bad!
Relax, buddy! Handling stuff like this is our specialty!
The Blight must have triggered a mutation that made them produce hallucinogenic toxins!

options: Why did you guys come here?
Did this kind of mushroom have hallucinogenic effects back then...?
Using experimental mushrooms to improve our meals is too risky.
First things first, let's wake up the workers.

scenes.summary: The awakened UWST workers blame themselves for the mushroom's mutation. Kay says she understands how Roger feels and tells you about her travels across Talos-II while waiting for you to wake up. And at last, she admits that all she's ever wanted was to share some delicious honey waffles with you.

lines.text: Sivka, are you alright? I didn't expect you and Roger to come here together.
I'm alright ... just a ... little dizzy...
Thank Talos you came when you did. Who knows what would've happened...
Supplies at the dam were scarce back then. Roger cultivated the mushroom just to make life a little better for everyone... No one saw this coming.
*Sigh* He must feel terrible seeing the mushroom he grew end up like this... Endmin, sorry for causing all this trouble.
No need to apologize. We have to deal with the changes caused by the Blight together.
I totally get Mr. Roger. When I share yummy things with everyone, my heart does a little happy dance too!
So that's why you always have honey waffles on you?
Actually ... that's kinda because of you, Endmin.
Because of me?
I knew early on that Endfield and the Endmin were leading the way, doing everything you could to build a better world here.
Rhodes Island carries a similar duty. I might not be able to shoulder all that big stuff for the Endmin yet ... but at least I can give you a taste of my honey waffles first!
Yeah! But everyone said you got hurt and slept for a reeeally looong time... And you never got to taste my honey waffle. That's the saddest thing ever!
I didn't know what I could do to help everyone, so I just kept wandering Talos-II, finding shiny new weapons and giving honey waffles to anyone who looked sad.
I've been to so many places, helped so many people, and made so many new friends.
Kjersch, La Fantoma, Morospolis... I walked ... a hundred ... a thousand ... a million ... zillions of miles!
The more places I visited, the more I realized how hard you and the other Endfield operators had worked for this planet!
So I kept walking and whispering to the stars, "Wake up, Endmin, wake up!" And when you did, I'd come running with an avalanche of honey waffle.
Oh! I made so many wishes — ten, a hundred, ten thousand, a hundred thousand ... a million wishes!
And then?
And then one day, my wish came true. I suddenly got a ton of honey waffles, and right after that, Endfield sent a message saying the Endmin was awake!
My awakening was part of the plan ... but who sent you the honey waffle...?
Uhh, I don't know either.
A real mystery, huh. Perhaps a fairy heard you and went, "Fine, here's your honey waffle."
Maybe it was the Endmin who granted your wish.
Who said that? I don't have fairy powers!
Hahaha, who did? Of course it's the storytellers in Hongshan.
Alright alright, enough chitchat. Let's go see Mr. Roger and make sure everyone's okay.
Man... If he'd just grown a sugarcane back then, none of this would've happened.
Sharing my honey waffle with you has always been my most sparkly wish!
You traveled all this way ... just for a wish like that?

scenes.summary: You find the girl, but something seems to be controlling her body and mind. Once she wakes up, Roger explains that stopping the spores means destroying the malignant threads. Kay proposes following those roots to the Hyphal Mass and wiping out the mushroom threat for good.

lines.text: Found her. Why is she hiding in here?
K-Kay...
Kay, you know her?
Not really. I've never seen her before.
Kay ... stay...
K-Kay ... we like you... stay with us ... we'll make your wish come true...
You're not her.
Kay, what's going on?
Why are you hiding in someone else's body? Who are you?!
Show yourself! And stop staring at me!
Kay ... what do you see?
Leave her body, or I'll bite you.
Be careful when working up high... No, wait. I must become one with the earth. I can't leave the ground.
Something strange was hiding inside her and talking through her...
Something strange? You mean there's another mind controlling all these people stuck in hallucinations?
Seems like it was trying to deceive you. Don't listen to anything it says.
Let's wake her up first.
Mmm... O-okay...
Those hallucinogenic spores could be carried by the wind to other places...
I'm worried about that too. We need to stop it from spreading.
Then let's just yank all the silly-looking threads out!
New threads will just keep growing back.
Then we follow the threads, find the mass, and rip that out too!
Follow the threads ... that could work, but it'll take us to the top of the dam.
Da Pan, the workers just recovered from their hallucinations. They'll need you to look after them. Kay and I will handle the rest of this.
Don't you worry, Uncle Pan! I'm gonna bake that nasty mushroom into honey waffle!
Endmin, I will...
What? Are you telling me there's a mind controlling those caught in the illusions?
Strain E21 was never capable of this... Could the mutation have caused other anomalies?
There's a strange root system wrapped around the giant mushroom. It definitely looks abnormal...
Maybe it's from the mutation Mr. Roger mentioned? Could these roots be behind it?
If it's linked to the mutated roots, destroying them might not be enough...
Those roots cluster together to form mutated fungal cores. So long as the core survives, it grants the roots full regenerative capabilities...

options: Very likely. It looks pretty questionable.

scenes.summary: The mushroom has grown dense, vine-like threads that block your path. Kay notices that spicy spores, combined with her honey waffles, could burn a path through.

lines.text: These threads look weird ... they're not like the ones before.
Not even your honey waffle will work this time?
Hmm... Wait, what's that burning smell?
Spicy spores ... these mushrooms just keep getting stranger.
Endmin, maybe we could try a new kind of honey waffle.
A "new kind"? I think I get it...
Hehe. Block my way? I'll burn you all to a crisp!

scenes.summary: You come across a lucid Landbreaker who doesn't seem hostile, and he knows Kay. He refers to the Malignant Hyphal Mass as the "Fungal King", and claims his brother can lead you to it. You play along, following his directions to find his brother.

lines.text: I don't wanna fight ... please put your weapon away.
Hmm? It's you...
Kay?
Endmin, he's not a bad guy. I know him.
I've met him before. He even shared his yummy, rock-hard bread with me!
You just ... wandered over while we were eating...
You all looked so happy eating so I got hungry too! And I didn't know that was your last bit of food...
Plus, I traded you a honey waffle for it, remember?
Nefarith is gone ... and she abandoned the Bonekrushers who once served her.
Hah. I knew it... That woman was always flip-flopping. First she sent us to Valley IV, then she dragged us to Wuling...
We're twins. He looks just like me.
You've been to Valley IV?
Actually no. She made us go there, but before we arrived, she changed her mind and sent us to Wuling instead...
Got stuck here before we even reached Wuling... If it weren't for her...
(So not all of Nefarith's Landbreakers believed in her...)
Bonekrushers? We're nothing like those damn maniacs. If Nefarith hadn't squeezed us, we'd never be running with her...
The Great Mushroom protects us! It feeds us! We MUST worship it! All hail the Fungal King!
Fungal King... What are you even saying? Oh no...
Should any trespassers dare harm our Fungal King, we will show them no mercy!
Oho... I get it! Ahem, since the Fungal King is so generous and wise, could we maybe have the honor of an audience?
The Fungal King does not grant audience to filthy outsiders! If you dare plot treason against him, how could I ever atone for bringing you to him?!
Ah, tribute bearers! Then it is my duty to usher you in. Truly, I am a model of devotion to our grand cause!
Go find my little brother. He's the Fungal King's right-hand herald, he'll get you in to see Him.
Go find him over there. If this succeeds and you're granted noble titles, we'll all be looking to you for a leg up.
Alright, pinky promise!

options: What are the Bonekrushers doing here?
So you're running with the mushrooms now?
And now you believe in mushrooms?
Kay, I reckon he's talking about the Hyphal Mass. Shall we...
We come as emissaries of Wuling, bearing tribute in submission.
We come bearing tribute to the renowned King, pledging our loyalty.
Little brother? What does he look like?
Play along and get the Mass's location?

scenes.summary: Many of the hallucinating Landbreakers have faded completely, their bodies turned into nutrients for the mushroom. Kay tells you they once shared their home and their meals with her. These were never ruthless thugs, they're victims of the mushroom crisis too.

lines.text: I hope you never ever get hungry again.
Kay, how did you become friends with these Landbreakers? I mean, they're a pretty rough bunch...
You're right, Endmin! Most Landbreakers I met out in the wilderness were usually bad guys... They even tried to steal my honey waffles and bully me!
But don't worry! I'm stronger! If they come at me, I'll take them down one by one!
They shared food with me, and let me stay in their shelter.
Even when their tummies were empty, they still shared food with me.
I trust you'll see them for who they are.
The wilderness can make people cruel ... but not you, Kay.
You mean it? I'm really that awesome?
Hehe, I AM really that awesome!
But the Landbreakers in this dam are different...
No one is born to fall in with a bad crowd, nor destined to roam the desolate wilderness forever, right?
If they had the choice, do you think they would stand with us to fight back against disasters?
He must've gone to the top floor.
To get up top, we have to open that door... The control room's over there.
Let's head over and try.
(When did Kay draw this? I didn't see.)
Done! ...Eep, what's that? ...Stop staring at me.
Same one as before?
Yeah ... but it's super angry this time...
Why do I feel like ... that thing is still onto me? Does it want my honey waffles?
But that's okay! My honey waffles will be here whenever I need them!
I bet there are people who need them waiting for us in the dam!

options: Kay, how about some honey waffles and a little break?

lines.text: Endmin, this diary smells like that Landbreaker.
Looks like he was pretty clear-headed when he wrote this...
Herald? Endmin, he's totally the little brother of that guy from before!
Looks like he's looking for the Hyphal Mass too.

options: His little brother wrote this? Let's read on.
So Kay's honey waffles shielded him from the hallucinations...
Guess he noticed something was up with the mushrooms.
Looks like we're after the same thing.
Read the diary
